_comment: agent-gateway island toolchain (P2, ADR-139): python 3.15 + uv, the oracle-fleet shape (python rides a nixpkgs FLAKE REF because devbox's search index lagged at 3.15.0rc2 while nixpkgs had 3.15.0 final, homelab#2610 — swap back to `"python": "3.15"` once `devbox search python@3.15` resolves the final); rclone for the specs-site + evidence publish/purge (scripts/lib/s3-publish.sh — minio-client was dropped 2026-10-28: nixpkgs marks it insecure/abandoned upstream), allure for the run's single-file report (scripts/allure-report.sh — the oracle-fleet pin, same store path) — mkdocs itself rides `uv run --no-project` with exact pins, see scripts/specs-build.sh). Run `devbox run ci` from THIS directory; the repo-root devbox.json reaches it through its `gateway-ci` script (diff-ci row `gateway-ci:^gateway/`). Nothing here is shared with the old openrouter-proxy, which stays on the repo-root toolchain untouched.
